title: Irving, TX — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Irving, TX: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Irving is a city in TX with a population of 256,684. Dallas suburb with corporate headquarters, DFW airport, and no state income tax. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8b growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.8.
